subject: gender as string fails but as a numeric runs fine

messages.author: 649d11b722428382
messages.subject: gender as string fails but as a numeric runs fine
parts:
Hi All,

In the following model when, I add 'gender' (as a string variable), I get the error: `infinite or missing values in 'x'`. However, when convert 'gender' to the numeric variable 'Female' (female = 1, male = 0, other = 2), the model runs fine.

Why this is happening? What is the interpretation of  'Female' in the model?

Thanks, Simon

#========== Code:
w4 <- read.csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/izeh/m/master/w4.csv', stringsAsFactors = F)  

model7 <- '

au_v=~ NA*audio_vocab_1+audio_vocab_2+audio_vocab_3+audio_vocab_4+audio_vocab_5+audio_vocab_6+text_vocab_1+dictation_1
ctst=~ ctest_1+ctest_2+ctest_3+ctest_4+ctest_5+ctest_6
dict=~ dictation_1+dictation_2+dictation_3+dictation_4+dictation_5+dictation_6+text_vocab_1
el_s=~ elicited_speech_1+elicited_speech_2+elicited_speech_3+elicited_speech_4+elicited_speech_5+elicited_speech_6
tx_v=~ NA*text_vocab_1+text_vocab_2+text_vocab_3+text_vocab_4+text_vocab_5+text_vocab_6+dictation_1

DET = ~ NA*au_v+ctst+dict+el_s+tx_v+Female
DET ~~ 1*DET
 au_v ~~ 1*au_v
 ctst ~~ 1*ctst
 dict ~~ 1*dict
 el_s ~~ 1*el_s
 tx_v ~~ 1*tx_v '

m7 <- cfa(model7, data = w4, meanstructure = TRUE, missing = "ML")

summary(m7, fit.measures=TRUE) ## Everything runs fine

#======== Now use 'gender' as a string variable instead of 'Female':

  model7 <- '

au_v=~ NA*audio_vocab_1+audio_vocab_2+audio_vocab_3+audio_vocab_4+audio_vocab_5+audio_vocab_6+text_vocab_1+dictation_1
ctst=~ ctest_1+ctest_2+ctest_3+ctest_4+ctest_5+ctest_6
dict=~ dictation_1+dictation_2+dictation_3+dictation_4+dictation_5+dictation_6+text_vocab_1
el_s=~ elicited_speech_1+elicited_speech_2+elicited_speech_3+elicited_speech_4+elicited_speech_5+elicited_speech_6
tx_v=~ NA*text_vocab_1+text_vocab_2+text_vocab_3+text_vocab_4+text_vocab_5+text_vocab_6+dictation_1

DET = ~ NA*au_v+ctst+dict+el_s+tx_v+gender
DET ~~ 1*DET
 au_v ~~ 1*au_v
 ctst ~~ 1*ctst
 dict ~~ 1*dict
 el_s ~~ 1*el_s
 tx_v ~~ 1*tx_v '

m7 <- cfa(model7, data = w4, meanstructure = TRUE, missing = "ML")

summary(m7, fit.measures=TRUE)   ## Everything fails.
